subject: MSA reframe — evidence tempo & pen-test scope proposal
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@atlashealth.com>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA reframe — evidence tempo & pen-test scope proposal

Hi Mike / Tara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I attached a short redline set that reframes the inspection/audit language to be bounded and operationally practical for both sides. The key changes we propose:

- Limited inspection window (one 5-business-day window per 12 months, with prior notice)
- Evidence tempo (tiered cadence for SOC 2 artifacts: daily logs for 14 days when requested, monthly summary exports otherwise; see attached matrix)
- Pen-test guardrails (allowed test types, pre-approved in-scope systems, remote testing by default; limited live-forensics requests only under pre-agreed SOW)
- Proof point substitution (accept certified SOC 2 report + targeted artifact snapshots instead of on-site wide-scope inspections)

Rationale: we want to give Atlas the visibility you need while keeping production stability and customer privacy intact. The attached "evidence_tempo_matrix.xlsx" maps the artifact types to expected deliverables and response SLAs.

Action items we think are sensible:
1) Legal confirms the MSA clause language in week 1 (Laura)
2) Security ops to confirm the pen-test guardrail list and any required staging windows (Vanessa / Karthik)
3) Atlas to confirm if a remote-only pen test is acceptable or whether on-prem/staging access will be required (Mike / Tara)

Can you review the attached and call out any absolute non-starters? If you're aligned, we can convert this into a formal redline and route to your legal ops for signature.

Attachments: Atlas_MSA_proposed_redlines_v1.docx (redline), evidence_tempo_matrix.xlsx (artifact cadence)

Thanks —

Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@atlashealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@atlashealth.com>, Legal Ops <legal-ops@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MSA reframe — evidence tempo & pen-test scope proposal

Jonas —

Appreciate the concise proposal and the matrix. A few quick notes from our side after an initial read:

- The 5-business-day window sounds workable, provided we get a 30-calendar-day notice. Can we add that notice period explicitly?
- On evidence tempo: the idea of accepting certified SOC 2 plus targeted snapshots is promising, but our compliance team will want an option for a deeper artifact pull once per year (not more than 7 business days) to sample controls.
- Pen-test: our preference is remote-first. We do, however, run annual internal compliance that occasionally requests on-prem/staging access for forensic traces. Can Redwood commit to a staged environment and a joint runbook if we need to escalate?

I'll route this to our Legal Ops and Compliance for formal feedback. Expect a fuller reply by Friday.

—Mike
Mike Jensen
Head of Security Compliance
Atlas Health
mike.jensen@atlashealth.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@atlashealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA reframe — evidence tempo & pen-test scope proposal

Mike / Jonah —

Thanks Mike — helpful initial signals. A couple drafting notes from legal after scanning the redline:

1) Notice period: we can agree to 30-calendar-day notice for the 5-business-day inspection window, but we need a mutuality clause (Redwood may also request the same cadence for our audits) and a hard cap on the number of inspections per 12 months (1).
2) Sampling pull: we can accept "deeper artifact pull once per 12 months" limited to 7 business days, but we must define the scope categories and exclude customer PII stores unless a court order or approved SOW is executed.
3) Pen-test guardrails: suggest the following language tweaks — require a named SOW for any interactive live-forensics or credentialed access; remote blackbox testing permitted with a minimum 7-day notice and a scan-window that does not exceed 48 continuous hours unless mutually agreed. We will insert an appendix that enumerates allowed tools and the staging endpoints.

Operational ask: Vanessa / Karthik, can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a staging environment with sanitized data for Atlas' use cases and how long spin-up takes (estimate in business days)? That will determine whether Atlas has to do any on-prem access.

If we get alignment on these four points, I'll produce a clean redline for Legal Ops to circulate.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@atlashealth.com>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA reframe — evidence tempo & pen-test scope proposal

Thanks all — summary and next steps: 

Summary of agreed positions so far:
- Inspection window: 1 x 5-business-day window per 12 months; 30-calendar-day notice; mutuality clause included.
- Artifact sampling: annual deeper pull limited to 7 business days; scope categories to be enumerated; PII excluded unless SOW/court order.
- Pen-test: remote-first default; remote blackbox allowed with 7-day notice; interactive or credentialed testing requires separate SOW; scan windows capped at 48 contiguous hours unless mutually agreed.
- Evidence substitution: SOC 2 + targeted artifact snapshots acceptable for most requests; exception clauses to be listed.

Action items:
1) Laura to publish a clean redline that incorporates the mutuality language and explicit exclusions — due Mon 10/25.
2) Vanessa to confirm staging environment option and spin-up estimate ("sanitized sandbox") — due Tue 10/26.
3) Karthik to draft a short runbook for joint pen-test execution and share allowed-tool appendix for legal — due Tue 10/26.
4) Mike/Tara to confirm whether Atlas accepts remote-only testing or will sometimes need staging/on-prem access; Legal Ops to provide feedback on sampling frequency — expected Fri 10/29.

Jonas — we'll queue the clean redline and then loop Legal Ops. If Atlas signs off on remote-first, we can finalize the MSA appendix and push to DocuSign.

Jonas Weber
